_comment: FC-1 INC-0 byte-identity gate, arm A (OFF).  50-station GPS+Galileo all-on golden
posture, 30 s cadence, 11 epochs (max_duration_s 300 -> N+1 inclusive), COLD start.
No network.fast_clock block at all: the tier is off by loader default, so the T2e
decimation hook keeps its bare `continue` and no FC-1 code path is entered.  This is
the reference every INC-0 comparison is made against.
Paired with _fc1_byteid_shadow.json, which arms the tier in SHADOW mode so the tick
body runs on EVERY epoch.  If ON-with-shadow reproduces this arm's products.txt and
estimation CSVs byte-for-byte, then OFF-vs-pre-card is identical a fortiori: the only
difference between OFF and the pre-card binary is a branch that is not taken.
That is a STRICTLY STRONGER runtime test than comparing two default-OFF builds, and
it is the isolation contract (SPEC section 7.1) rather than just the arming contract.
